elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Clause (v) requires Kubient, upon expiry or termination and at Customer's request, to provide transition assistance. The request condition appropriately makes the assistance Customer-elected.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: Clause (v) expressly provides transition assistance for up to 6 months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Within 30 days after expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) requires Kubient to return Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) expressly requires a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete that Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Clause (vii) requires Kubient to delete the Customer Data from its systems after the return.

elements.element: After deleting the returned Customer Data, Vendor must certify the deletion.
elements.evidence: Clause (vii) requires Kubient to certify the deletion to Customer in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Clause (v) requires Kubient to provide transition assistance upon expiry or termination at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The stated availability of up to 6 months encompasses the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) requires Kubient to return Customer Data to Customer in a standard machine-readable format, which satisfies the export requirement.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (vi) expressly imposes a 30-day deadline after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative redline satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It preserves the original confidentiality-return obligation and makes clear that Customer Data must be returned before deletion. It is not strictly minimal because it adds unnecessary scope language covering all Content, Requests, and other data relating to Customer, as well as a written-certification formality not expressly required by the position.
